create_layoutbox: create a LayoutBox instance with label, position, and optional top_k confidence dict
build_layoutresult: build a LayoutResult containing a list of LayoutBox bboxes, image bbox coords, and sliced flag
test_layoutbox: test the LayoutBox class inherits from PolygonBox with label, position, and top_k fields
review_layoutresult: review the LayoutResult Pydantic model with bboxes, image_bbox, and sliced attributes
summarize_layoutbox: summarize the LayoutBox schema used for layout detection bounding box results
